catalyst_rows.indication: BD, MDD, PTSD and Alzheimer's (Lithium in Brain Phase II imaging)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: The first of five clinical trials began in May 2025 with healthy volunteers, which will assess AL001's brain/plasma pharmacokinetics, safety, and distribution compared to lithium carbonate. Topline results are expected by year-end 2025, with follow-up trials in BD, MDD, PTSD and Alzheimer's launching through early 2026.
